sinopsis.es: Eduardo vive atrapado en una asfixiante rutina: cada cinco minutos debe dar cuerda a una enorme máquina de cobre para que el tiempo no se detenga. Por sus cinco ventanas descubre mundos que le gustan más que el suyo: en uno se enamora y en otro encuentra a su único amigo. Ante el temor de que el tiempo cobre su vida, usa su ingenio para escapar.
sinopsis.en: Eduardo is trapped in a suffocating routine, like just another cog in a massive copper machine that he must wind every five minutes to keep time from stopping. Through its five windows, he discovers worlds he likes more than his own: in one, he falls in love; in another, he finds his only friend. Fearing that time itself may claim his life, he uses his ingenuity to escape his confinement and achieve freedom.
